content:
maya: Heads up — onboarding with NovaLabs. Their web client is hitting 429s right after startup during SDK preflight. Happens reliably within ~30s of users opening the app. Logs attached below.

maya: ```
[2026-03-22T15:04:12Z] init: /v1/preflight 200 x 6
[2026-03-22T15:04:13Z] init: /v1/preflight 429 x 24
[2026-03-22T15:04:13Z] init: RetryImmediate -> 429
[2026-03-22T15:04:14Z] heartbeat: 200
[2026-03-22T15:04:15Z] init: /v1/preflight 429 x 18
```

maya: They say each client tab does a preflight + telemetry warmup on open (no splay). App usage spikes when customers open multiple tabs.

josh: Are they using ephemeral keys per session or a shared API key? Also which SDK version?

maya: Using browser SDK v1.7.2, and they initially implemented a shared static key from server for dev onboarding.

eli: That lines up — shared key + no preflight splay = thundering herd. Recommend: 1) issue ephemeral tokens for each client session 2) add randomized init splay + client-side inflight cap 3) server-side preflight coalescing.

josh: Quick mitigation we can suggest to customer now: throttle preflight calls and add jitter. Example snippet:```js
// client init splay
const jitter = () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 800) + 200; // 200-1000ms
setTimeout(() => sdk.init(), jitter());
// simple inflight guard
if (window.__RI_inflightInit) return;
window.__RI_inflightInit = true;
sdk.init().finally(() => window.__RI_inflightInit = false);
```

maya: I'll send this to the customer. Anything we should change server-side for them while they roll that out?

eli: On our side we can enable preflight coalescing for their tenant and temporarily raise the burst window while they migrate off the static key. Also we should add a small 2s leaky-bucket window for preflight from their tenant to avoid immediate 429s during bursts.

rl-bot: RateLimitAlert: detected 429 spike for tenant "novalabs" between 2026-03-22T15:04:12Z and 2026-03-22T15:07:00Z — peak 140 req/min. Suggested action: enable tenant preflight_coalesce + temporary burst_increase.

josh: I'll create a config change request for infra with the temporary burst increase and coalescing flag. maya, can you confirm they can switch to ephemeral keys (we have email confirmation)?

maya: Confirmed — they want to switch today. I'll coordinate a short Maintenance window (10 mins) and share steps.

eli: Nice. Post-change follow-up items: monitor 429s for 2 hours, watch per-route latency, and capture a sample of init traces for their tenant. If 429s persist after client splay + ephemeral keys, escalate to runtime team.

maya: Thanks — will update the ticket and loop in the SE for rollout support :thumbsup:
